rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Hong Kong Cantonese word for a fabric floor covering.

example.english: We put down a new carpet in the living room, and the whole place feels warmer right away.
example.traditional: 客廳鋪咗張新地氈，成間屋即刻暖好多。
example.jyutping: haak3 teng1 pou1 zo2 zoeng1 san1 dei6 zin1 sing4 gaan1 uk1 zik1 hak1 nyun5 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this as a common alternative for the same complete floor covering, especially in more neutral or written contexts.

example.english: During the renovation, the designer suggested using carpet throughout the flat.
example.traditional: 裝修嗰陣，設計師建議全屋鋪地毯。
example.jyutping: zong1 sau1 go2 zan6 cit3 gai3 si1 gin3 ji5 cyun4 uk1 pou1 dei6 taam2
